sents.t: Yeah. And the big fish protects them.
sents.zh: 对，而且大鱼会保护它们

sents.t: I don't know, it felt like a fish.
sents.zh: 我也说不上来，摸起来就像条鱼

sents.t: Wow. Your life is so much cooler than mine.
sents.zh: 哇，你的生活比我的酷多了

sents.t: Otherwise, I never would've seen any of this.
sents.zh: 不然的话，这些我根本不可能看到

sents.t: Have you ever gone to the human town?
But, but my dad told me all about it.
sents.zh: 不过，不过我爸跟我讲过那里的一切

sents.t: So, I'm pretty much an expert.
sents.zh: 所以，我差不多算是个专家了

sents.t: You're lucky he lets you do what you want.
sents.zh: 你真幸运，他让你想干嘛就干嘛

sents.t: Hey, you remember that time we almost hit that rock?
sents.zh: 嘿，还记得那次我们差点撞上那块石头吗

sents.t: And we flew through the air, and I was like, “Yeah!” And then you were like, “No!”
sents.zh: 我们飞到了空中，我当时喊“耶！”，然后你喊“不要！”

sents.t: Wouldn't it be amazing to have a real Vespa?
sents.zh: 要是能有一辆真正的韦士柏，那该多棒啊

cards.ex: Otherwise means “if not” or “if that did not happen.” Luca means that without Alberto, he never would have seen any of this.
exs: Wear a coat. Otherwise, you will get cold.
cards.note: Day 8 原句：“Otherwise, I never would've seen any of this.”（不然的话，这些我根本不可能看到）

cards.ex: An expert is a person who knows a lot about something. Alberto says he is pretty much an expert on the human town, but he has never been there.
exs: My grandma is an expert at making pasta.
cards.note: Day 8 原句：“So, I'm pretty much an expert.”（所以，我差不多算是个专家了）

cards.ex: A rock is a big, hard piece of stone. Luca and Alberto almost hit a rock when they rode their Vespa.
exs: The boat almost hit a big rock near the beach.
cards.note: Day 8 原句：“Hey, you remember that time we almost hit that rock?”（嘿，还记得那次我们差点撞上那块石头吗）
